context.transcript:
Good morning, Ms. Hamasaki.
I'm Charles, one of the nurses in the office.
I just have a couple of questions before the doctor comes in.
Okay.
My notes say you're here for your annual checkup, but according to our records, you had a checkup six months ago.
Is that correct?
No, it's not.
Oh.
Well, we've recently started using a new record-keeping system, and some information didn't transfer correctly.
Just to let you know, I did visit the office earlier this year to have a prescription refilled, but I didn't have an exam at that time.
I'll update your information, then.
The doctor will be right in.
context.transcript_translation:
早上好，滨崎女士。
我是查尔斯，诊所的护士之一。
在医生进来之前，我有些问题想问您。
好的。
我的记录显示您是来做年度体检的，但根据我们的记录，您六个月前已经做过体检了。
对吗？
不，不对。
哦。
嗯，我们最近开始使用一个新的病历系统，有些信息没有正确转移。
只是告诉您一声，我今年早些时候来诊所续配处方药的，但当时并没有进行检查。
那我更新您的信息吧。
医生马上就来了。
